blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-newcomer-1 (bucket hides the premium threshold in a bitmask one-liner that does not compute it) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
export const bucket = (ps: Price[]) =>
  ps.reduce<Record<string, Price[]>>((a, p) => ((a[(p.cents >> 4) & 0x3e8 ? "hi" : "lo"] ||= []).push(p), a), {});
findings.recommendation: Replace the one-liner with a plain loop or two filters on a named constant, e.g. `const PREMIUM_THRESHOLD_CENTS = 1000;` and `p.cents >= PREMIUM_THRESHOLD_CENTS`, so that the rule from the proposal ("10 euros and more") reads in the code. The bitmask `(cents >> 4) & 0x3e8` is not a comparison with 1000 cents: 500 cents (5 euros) gives 31 & 1000 = 8, so "hi"; 16384 cents (163.84 euros) gives 1024 & 1000 = 0, so "lo". A newcomer cannot see that the expression is wrong without decoding it bit by bit; the author must fix the behavior (the newcomer does not change it).
findings.title: bucket hides the premium threshold in a bitmask one-liner that does not compute it

findings.evidence:
export const bucket = (ps: Price[]) =>
  ps.reduce<Record<string, Price[]>>((a, p) => ((a[(p.cents >> 4) & 0x3e8 ? "hi" : "lo"] ||= []).push(p), a), {});
findings.recommendation: Name the function after what it does (e.g. `splitByPriceBand`), use readable parameter names (`prices`, `groups`, `price`), and return a typed shape such as `{ cheap: Price[]; premium: Price[] }` instead of `Record<string, Price[]>` with magic keys "hi"/"lo"; today a caller cannot know the keys without reading the body, and a band with no price is absent instead of empty.
findings.title: Obscure names and untyped string keys in bucket

findings.recommendation: Add a `pricing` test that describes the behavior at the boundary (999 cents is cheap, 1000 cents is premium, a large price is premium). No test file is in the repository, so the task was checked off without a test that documents — or would have caught — the behavior of `bucket`.
findings.title: The verification test cited by the task does not exist

findings.recommendation: Put the unit where it applies: a doc comment on the `cents` field (`/** Amount in cents. */`) instead of a detached JSDoc block above the interface.
findings.title: Module comment reads as a comment on the interface
